g.text: Four containers in prodskycraftswcsa — protection is set once on the account, tiering per rule
2 · Two switches guard all four at once
soft delete 7 days, blobs and snapshots
versioning every overwrite keeps the old one
# both apply to all containers, always
# rules target a prefix, evaluated once a day
Soft delete protects against your mistakes. It does not protect against a deleted storage account.
az CLI — container, then the account-wide switches
the cost of Archive is not storage, it is time
reading it needs a rehydration first
# plan restores, do not improvise them
